bug_report:
RFE: support outputting diagnostics in *multiple* formats
Currently there is a single diagnostic output format, specified via -fdiagnostics-format=.

It would be nice if it were possible to generate both text *and* SARIF output from a single invocation of the compiler.

This could be done be revamping -fdiagnostics-format= to support multiple "sinks", somehow, but see alsobug 115970.
